scripts.// prepare: Builds dist/ automatically after `npm install`, because this package's entry point is dist/index.js and the seed script, gateway and API all import it. It is guarded on the sources being present: Docker's dependency layer copies package.json files only, and an unguarded build there fails with TS5058 and breaks the image build.
scripts.prepare: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('tsconfig.json')&&fs.existsSync('src')){require('child_process').execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{console.log('[shared] prepare: no sources here (dependency-only install) - skipping build')}"
